categories.name: Hair Salon
categories.description: Professional hair services, salon-grade retail, and styling tools for colour, cuts, treatments, and everyday hair care.

children.name: Haircuts and Styling
children.description: Precision cuts, blowouts, and occasion styling for every hair type and length.

children.name: Colour Services
children.description: Root touch-ups, full colour, balayage, gloss, and colour correction by trained colourists.

children.name: Treatments and Repair
children.description: Keratin, bond repair, scalp rituals, and deep conditioning to restore strength and shine.

children.name: Texture and Extensions
children.description: Silk presses, perm waves, and clip-in or tape-in extensions for length and volume.

children.name: Salon Retail
children.description: Shampoo, conditioner, oils, and styling products used on the salon floor, ready to take home.

children.name: Salon Tools
children.description: Dryers, irons, shears, and brushes chosen for daily professional use.

products.name: Women's Cut and Blow Dry
products.short_description: A tailored cut finished with a smooth salon blow dry.
products.description: Consultation, precision cut, and blow dry styled to your everyday look. Includes a light treatment rinse. Allow 60 minutes.

products.name: Men's Classic Cut
products.short_description: Clean clipper and scissor work with a neck shave finish.
products.description: Classic men's cut with clipper fade or scissor work, hot towel neck shave, and styling. Allow 30 minutes.

products.name: Children's Haircut
products.short_description: Gentle cuts for children aged 12 and under.
products.description: Patient, age-appropriate haircut with a simple style finish. A parent or guardian must stay for the appointment.

products.name: Bridal Updo Styling
products.short_description: Occasion updo with trial-ready pinning and finish.
products.description: Long-wear updo for weddings and events, including texture, pinning, and a setting spray finish. Trial booking sold separately.

products.name: Blowout Styling
products.short_description: Wash, condition, and round-brush blowout.
products.description: Shampoo, conditioner, and a smooth or bouncy blowout using professional heat tools and protectant.

products.name: Root Touch-Up
products.short_description: Regrowth colour matched to your existing shade.
products.description: Permanent or demi colour applied to new growth, rinsed, and finished with a blow dry. Strand test required for first-time colour guests.

products.name: Full Head Colour
products.short_description: All-over colour from roots through ends.
products.description: Full-head application for a uniform result, followed by a bond-supporting rinse and style. Extra length or density may add time.

products.name: Balayage Highlights
products.short_description: Hand-painted highlights with a toner gloss.
products.description: Freehand balayage, toner, and gloss for a lived-in result. Includes a blow dry. Plan for 2.5 to 3 hours.

products.name: Toner and Gloss
products.short_description: Refresh tone and add shine between colour visits.
products.description: Demi-permanent toner and gloss to correct brassiness and restore shine. Ideal 4 to 6 weeks after highlights.

products.name: Colour Correction
products.short_description: Consultation-led correction for uneven or unwanted colour.
products.description: In-depth consultation and multi-step colour correction. A deposit and in-person assessment are required before the service date.

products.name: Keratin Smoothing Treatment
products.short_description: Frizz control and smoother styling for weeks.
products.description: Keratin smoothing service to reduce frizz and cut blow-dry time. Aftercare shampoo is recommended. Results typically last 8 to 12 weeks.

products.name: Bond Repair Treatment
products.short_description: In-salon bond builder for colour-treated hair.
products.description: Professional bond-building treatment to improve elasticity and reduce breakage, finished with a conditioning mask.

products.name: Scalp Detox Ritual
products.short_description: Clarifying cleanse and scalp massage.
products.description: Clarifying cleanse, exfoliating scalp treatment, and massage to reset buildup before colour or styling.

products.name: Deep Conditioning Mask
products.short_description: Intensive moisture mask with steam.
products.description: Custom moisture or protein mask under steam, then a rinse and light style. Add on to any cut or colour.

products.name: Hair Spa Ritual
products.short_description: Full ritual: cleanse, mask, serum, and blowout.
products.description: A longer restorative visit covering cleanse, mask, leave-in serum, and a finished blowout.

products.name: Tape-In Extension Application
products.short_description: Professional tape-in application. Hair wefts priced separately.
products.description: Sectioning and tape-in application by a trained stylist. Weft colour match and hair cost are quoted after consultation.

products.name: Clip-In Hair Extensions
products.short_description: Seven-piece clip-in set in heat-friendly fibre.
products.description: A reusable clip-in set for length and volume. Heat friendly up to 180 C. Colour-matched in salon on request.

products.name: Silk Press
products.short_description: Blowout and press for a sleek, shiny finish.
products.description: Wash, blow dry, and silk press with heat protectant. Best on relaxed or naturally textured hair. Allow 90 minutes.

products.name: Perm Wave
products.short_description: Chemical wave for lasting body and curl.
products.description: Rod wrap and perm solution for lasting texture. Includes a neutralizing rinse and style. Strand test required.

products.name: Repair Shampoo 250ml
products.short_description: Bond-supporting shampoo for coloured and heat-styled hair.
products.description: Sulfate-free cleanser used on the salon floor. Helps reduce breakage and keep colour looking even. 250 ml.

products.name: Moisture Conditioner 250ml
products.short_description: Daily conditioner for softness without weight.
products.description: Lightweight moisture conditioner paired with the repair shampoo. Detangles and adds slip for easier styling. 250 ml.

products.name: Heat Protectant Spray
products.short_description: Thermal spray for irons and dryers up to 230 C.
products.description: Mist through damp hair before blow-drying or straightening. Helps reduce heat damage and flyaways.

products.name: Argan Hair Oil 100ml
products.short_description: Finishing oil for shine and frizz control.
products.description: A few drops on mid-lengths and ends to seal, add shine, and calm frizz. Suitable for most textures.

products.name: Matte Styling Clay
products.short_description: Flexible hold clay with a natural matte finish.
products.description: Work a small amount through dry hair for texture and hold that restyles through the day.

products.name: Dry Shampoo
products.short_description: Oil-absorbing spray for day-two hair.
products.description: Spray at the roots, wait, then brush through to refresh volume between washes.

products.name: Smoothing Hair Serum
products.short_description: Anti-frizz serum for humidity and blowouts.
products.description: Silicone-blend serum to lock a blowout and keep ends looking polished in humid weather.

products.name: Professional Hair Dryer
products.short_description: Ionic salon dryer with concentrator and diffuser.
products.description: Lightweight AC-motor dryer used on the floor. Includes concentrator and diffuser attachments.

products.name: Ceramic Flat Iron
products.short_description: 25 mm ceramic plates with adjustable heat.
products.description: Salon ceramic straightener with adjustable temperature and floating plates for even pressure.

products.name: Round Brush Set
products.short_description: Three ceramic round brushes for blowouts.
products.description: Small, medium, and large ceramic round brushes with heat-resistant barrels.

products.name: Cutting Shears
products.short_description: Stainless steel 5.5 inch cutting shears.
products.description: Offset-handle cutting shears for daily salon work. Includes a case and tension key.

products.name: Salon Cutting Cape
products.short_description: Water-resistant cutting cape with snap collar.
products.description: Lightweight, water-resistant cape with an adjustable snap neck. Wipes clean between guests.
